entities.name: Kaufmannskirche (Erfurt)
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Kaufmannskirche is a church building in the historical centre of the city of Erfurt in Thuringia, Germany. It is located at the north end of Erfurt's Anger square and has been Lutheran since 1521.
